pages.title: Ministry of the Environment and Energy (Greece) - Wikipedia
pages.excerpt:
The**Ministry of the Environment and Energy**([Greek](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greek_language):Υπουργείο Περιβάλλοντος και Ενέργειας) is a[government department](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_(government_department))of[Greece](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greece)responsible for[environmental](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Environmental_policy)and[energy policy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Energy_policy). It was created on 7 October 2009 as the**Ministry of the Environment, Energy and Climate Change**to succeed the[Ministry for the Environment, Physical Planning and Public Works](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_for_the_Environment,_Physical_Planning_and_Public_Works). The incumbent minister is[Theodoros Skylakakis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Theodoros_Skylakakis)of[New Democracy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_Democracy_(Greece)).
